full_core_verified_scope: Semantic coverage of the mathematical results of the specified document: Theorems1-7, Pontryagin necessity and the continuous optimal representative, canonical costate solution properties and polynomial-growth uniqueness, global state dynamics, and equation(30), corresponding to the Section12 result inventory. This is a consolidated audit of multiple Lean theorems, not a new kernel-checked theorem representing the PDF as a whole.

global_state_dynamics.control_class: Measurable real controls with 0<=u(t)<=U for every t>=0.
global_state_dynamics.initial_data: Arbitrary nonnegative real initial resource and state.
global_state_dynamics.construction: The same explicit resource and omega functions are defined on the entire half-line. Stage27 supplies control interval integrability for every T>=0. Stage12 and stage29 give the initial conditions, absolute continuity on every [0,T], and both state ODEs almost everywhere there.
global_state_dynamics.uniqueness: On every [0,T], stage13 identifies any resource solution with the canonical resource. Substituting that identity into the state equation allows stage30.omega_representation to identify the state solution. Since T is arbitrary, uniqueness holds throughout the nonnegative half-line.
global_state_dynamics.zero_initial_resource: Included by the general lemmas; the stricter positive-initial-resource theorem in stage14 is not used to justify this case.
global_state_dynamics.regularity_convention: Global solutions are locally absolutely continuous: absolutely continuous on each finite [0,T].
global_state_dynamics.nonnegativity_and_growth: Stage30 proves nonnegativity and a finite affine upper bound for omega. The audit does not identify this alternative bound with the differently written omega bound in equation(5).

result_inventory.basis: General solution and uniqueness lemmas, detailed below.
